newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Asian Dev Bank clears $45.6 mln loan to Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: Asian Dev Bank clears $45.6 mln loan to Indonesia.

text.p: The Asian Development Bank said on Thursday it approved a $45.6 million loan to Indonesia for a conservation and development project.

The loan will help arrest the damage to the ecosystem of the Segara Abnakan lagoon, a breeding ground for fish, shrimps and other aquatic products as well as a source of mangrove wood and wood by-products, the ADB said.
The total cost of the project is $76.89 million.
Half of the loan amount, or $22.8-million, will carry a yearly service charge of one percent with the loan to be repaid in 35 years.
The remaining $22.8 million will be for 25 years with a five-year grace period and carry an interest rate of 6.82 percent, the ADB said.
